environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU

fine_tuning.schedule: linear warm-up then per-step cosine to 0; masks re-applied after every step

bn_recalibration.procedure: reset running stats, cumulative average over Dense-Aug-augmented training views in train mode; no weight update

calibration.estimator: per-example absolute CosFace Taylor, BN in eval mode, fp32
calibration.normalization: OAGP: per condition and layer, divide by mean + 1e-12
